result.planSummary: Completed the SV-02-001 follow-up by surfacing artifact-version producing-process provenance in the review UI, keeping the server response assertions explicit on version summaries, and re-running the story and epic gates successfully.

changedFiles.reason: Removed artifact-row process ownership from checkpoint persistence so revising an existing project artifact keeps one stable artifact identity and writes a new version row instead.
Aligned the in-memory platform store with Story 2 by deriving artifact summaries from latest version history and avoiding ownership-style rewrites during checkpoint persistence.
Preserved producing-process display provenance when artifact review content loading degrades into an error state.
Made the selected artifact version visibly show producing-process provenance in the review panel.
Made each artifact version option visibly show producing-process provenance in the version list.
Added durable-state coverage for multi-process revisions keeping one artifact identity while recording separate version provenance.
Added server coverage proving project-shell artifact summaries resolve currentVersionLabel and updatedAt from the latest durable version.
Strengthened artifact review API assertions so version summaries returned to the browser include producing-process provenance.
Added UI assertions proving selected-version provenance is visible in the artifact review panel, including degraded states.
Added UI assertions proving version-summary provenance is visible in the artifact version switcher.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/artifact-review-panel.test.ts tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts tests/service/server/artifact-review-api.test.ts --environment jsdom

findingsFixed: Surfaced producing-process provenance directly in the artifact review UI so the selected version now visibly shows both producedByProcessDisplayLabel and producedByProcessId.
Surfaced producing-process provenance in the version switcher so earlier and current version summaries visibly identify which process produced each revision.
Added explicit server-response assertions that artifact review version summaries returned to the browser carry producedByProcessId and producedByProcessDisplayLabel.
Reconfirmed the full story after the UI fix with passing green-verify and verify-all runs.
findingsSurfaced: InMemoryPlatformStore still carries a synthetic artifact-version fallback for seeded test data that lack explicit version rows; that is a test-store compatibility shim, not the Convex production path changed by this story.

ArtifactSummary’s TypeScript shape still tolerates legacy optional ownership fields for fixture compatibility even though the runtime schema/output strip them; broader cleanup of those compatibility fields is adjacent follow-up work, not required to satisfy Story 2.

result.recommendedNextStep: Return this story to verification and have the verifier rerun AC-2.2 / TC-2.2a / TC-2.2b against the artifact review UI and version-switcher provenance display.
